description: Connect the Bookmark app on your phone to listen to audiobooks on the go.

connect.title: Connect Your Device
connect.description: Follow these steps to connect the Bookmark app on iOS or Android to your Bookmark server.

step1.title: Install Bookmark
step1.description: Install the Bookmark app on your iPhone or Android device.

step2.title: Generate QR Code
step2.description: Click the button below to generate a secure connection QR code.

step3.title: Scan or tap to open
step3.description: Scan the QR code with your phone's camera, or open the link from your device. Bookmark will launch with your server and key pre-filled.

step1.title: Install Bookmark
step1.description: Install the Bookmark app on your iPhone or Android device.

step2.title: Enter your server address
step2.description: Open the app and type the server URL shown below. The app checks which sign-in methods your server offers.

step3.title: Sign in with your account
step3.description: Use the same email and password you use here, or tap the SSO button if your server has single sign-on enabled.

step4.title: That is it
step4.description: The app creates its own access key for this device, so there is nothing to copy across. You can revoke it later under Preferences.

signIn.note: No API key needed: the app generates one for itself once you have signed in. If you have already reached the key limit, the app will tell you so.

step1.title: Open Bookmark
step1.description: Launch the Bookmark app on your phone.

step2.title: Generate API Key
step2.description: Go to Preferences in this web app and generate an API key. Copy the key for the next step.

step3.title: Enter server URL
step3.description: On Bookmark's setup screen, paste the server URL shown below.

step4.title: Enter API key
step4.description: Paste the API key you generated.

step5.title: Connect
step5.description: Tap Connect to verify the credentials and finish setup.

limitReached.title: API key limit reached
limitReached.description: You've reached the maximum of {max} API keys. Remove an unused key in Preferences before generating a new connection.

app.keyLimitError: API key limit reached. Remove an unused key in Preferences first.
app.scanInstructions: Scan this QR code with your phone's camera
app.scanNote: Make sure Bookmark is installed. When you scan the code, the app will open with your server and key pre-filled; tap Connect inside the app to finish.
app.openInAppNote: Already on your phone? Tap the button above to open Bookmark with your details pre-filled.
